name: Resistance Floor -1000 (Character Screen display)
description: Client-side display only. The character sheet clamps the Fire / Lightning / Cold / Poison values it prints to a minimum of -100 in its own loop (0x1414E6E70), independently of the gameplay clamp, so with the gameplay floor at -1000 the panel would still read '-100' for a player below that. This lowers the display floor to match. Optional: drop it in only if players in your build can reach negative resistances past -100. It has no effect on damage.

patches.description: Character-sheet resistance loop, shared clamp for all five resist rows (magic has no text field, the other four print). 'mov eax,-100; mov edi,ecx; cmp r15d,eax; cmovg eax,r15d; cmp eax,ecx; cmovl edi,eax' - eax is preloaded with the display floor and is also the cmp threshold, same single-immediate property as the gameplay sites. Upper bound (min(75+maxresist, 95), the B9 5F 00 00 00 just before it) is untouched. Full witness from 0x14E728C: 8D 4F 4B 83 F9 5F 7C 05 B9 5F 00 00 00 B8 9C FF FF FF.
